user.title: Set up HidrateSpark
user.description: Choose a HidrateSpark bottle that's currently advertising, or enter its Bluetooth address manually. The bottle must be paired with the official app at least once before this will work.

data_description.model: Sets the weight-sensor calibration for your bottle. Pick 'Other' to enter a custom capacity. The scale self-tunes from your sips over time.
data_description.size_ml: Only used when the model is 'Other'.
